The coat hangs from a shoulder yoke (a shelf wider than the chest that the sleeve heads sit on, dropping steeply to the collar), breaks at a waist seam where the skirts stand off, and its front edges roll outward so the fronts read as cloth hanging over the waistcoat, not a shell
note: r21, one auditor, pairs 1 CUR-BETTER / 1 SAME; the CUR-BETTER credited to a form highlight and the damask scale, 'geometry itself looks identical'; torso still 'an egg, shoulders slope into it, sleeves with no shoulder seam' at SEV 2. Next route: the shoulder has to read at 1x - sleeve heads set into the yoke with a seam, the chest narrower against the shoulders, coat panels with a hip flare.

idea: Sleeve heads set into the yoke as proud ellipsoids with an armhole seam of the darker velvet, the chest and waist narrowed against the shoulders, the skirts flared from the waist seam, and a side-body seam down each side so the coat reads as panels
note: r22, one auditor, pairs 2 PREV-BETTER (FORM) / 1 CUR-BETTER (LIGHT, not the route): 'left reads a flatter, wider shield', 'shoulder line sits further in on the previous'. Proud sleeve heads and a flared skirt widen the silhouette; a child's torso wants slope and taper, not width. Reverted in v122. Next route for the torso, if any: sloping shoulders (the yoke falling toward the sleeve) and a waist that reads above the desk, not more at the shoulders or hem.

idea: Face form in geometry: eye openings 15% smaller with a thinner lid margin and shorter lashes, a brow ridge and orbital rim so the eye sits in a socket, a taller nose bridge, a cheekbone plane with a soft hollow under it, jaw corners and a chin undercut so the lower face is not a sphere
note: r23, one auditor: FACE-FORM pairs 2 CUR-BETTER (FORM: 'narrower jaw, modelled nose bridge and chin; fuller cheeks, more child-like'); FACE-FORM fell SEV 3 -> 2 for this auditor. The idea also carried the eye change, which regressed (split off as I43 and reverted). Kept: brow ridge, orbital shelf, nose bridge, cheek plane with hollow, jaw corners, chin undercut, lateral fade toward the hairline, hair roots standing off the relief. Next route: 'wide heavy jaw, square lower face, puffed cheeks' - narrow the jaw, raise and soften the chin, carry cheek volume higher under the eye.
